subject: Post-demo cost scenarios, target $/1M tokens & trial credit check
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@edgecollective.ai>
To: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@edgecollective.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Thanks for the demo — follow-up on cost scenarios

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — really helpful. A couple of follow-ups from our side so we can align internally:

- Can you send a short breakdown of expected token volumes and a couple of pricing scenarios ($/1M tokens) for a 3-month pilot?
- We need an idea of how credits would be applied and whether we can get an interim top-up if burn is higher than expected.
- Our procurement wants a rough target monthly spend (band) we can include in the business case.

Attached the usage snapshot from our staging tests. Happy to jump on a quick call if that helps.

Cheers,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of ML Products, Edge Collective
liam@edgecollective.ai
+1 415-555-0192

Attachments: usage-screenshot.png

From: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@edgecollective.ai>
Cc: jordan_blake <jordan@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, procurement@edgecollective.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Thanks for the demo — follow-up on cost scenarios

Hi Liam — great talking earlier. Quick recap plus the scenarios you asked for.

Recap / assumptions
- Pilot window: 3 months (Jul-Sep)
- Staging avg prompt + response length: ~850 tokens per API call (per your snapshot)
- Baseline concurrent qps for pilot: 10 (peaks to ~25)

Pricing scenarios (illustrative):
1) Conservative: 100k calls/day => ~85M tokens/day => ~2.55B tokens/month. Target unit: $900 / 1M tokens => ~$2,295 / month (unit) * (2.55k units) = ~$2.3M/month — note: this is raw model token cost before batching/kv cache savings.
2) Moderate: 40k calls/day => ~34M tokens/day => ~1.02B tokens/month. Target unit: $750 / 1M tokens => ~$765k/month.
3) Optimized: 10k calls/day with prefix caching and batching => ~250M tokens/month effective => $550 / 1M tokens => ~$137.5k/month.

What matters for economics: batching, KV/prefix cache hit rate, and whether you pin smaller context models for high-frequency intents. We can run a short eval on your trace to produce a recommended band.

Credits & trial top-up
- We can provision an initial 50k trial credits (applied to billed usage) to get started.
- If burn exceeds our projection in the first 14 days, we can approve one-time top-up of up to 250k credits on a case-by-case basis pending brief ops call.

Next steps
1) If you confirm the pilot target (conservative/moderate/optimized), we'll run a 48-hour trace evaluation and return a tuned cost projection.
2) Jordan will prepare a brief credit authorization and a one-page procurement checklist.
3) If you want the PO path, loop in procurement and we'll drop a starter MPA (attached).

I'll attach the demo deck and MPA draft. Happy to hop on a 20-min call if you want to walk through the numbers.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.ai

Attachments: edge-demo-deck.pdf, mpa-draft.pdf

From: jordan_blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@edgecollective.ai>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, procurement@edgecollective.ai
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Thanks for the demo — follow-up on cost scenarios

Hi Liam — looping in the commercial side with some straightforward bands and the credit offer Priyom mentioned.

Commercial bands (indicative, post-discounts)
- Tier A (high volume): >1B tokens/month => $480 - $600 / 1M tokens (multi-month committed pricing)
- Tier B (mid): 250M - 1B tokens/month => $650 - $800 / 1M tokens
- Tier C (pilot): <250M tokens/month => $900 - $1,100 / 1M tokens (on-demand)

Pilot credit approach
- We can front-load 50k credits at signup to cover initial exploratory traffic.
- Because you are a product-led team, we're prepared to approve a one-time trial top-up of 200k credits if you hit an agreed burn trigger (we'd ask for a short usage of the trace and a 15-min ops sync to validate).

Procurement + PO
- If procurement wants an estimated monthly spend to include in the business case, use the Moderate scenario figure (~$0.75M/month) as a midline — we will refine it after trace eval.
- We can accept a standard PO referencing the MPA in draft; legal has pre-approved redlines for pilot terms (I attached a checklist).

I'll also open a HubSpot deal activity with the proposed credit allocation so procurement can see it.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call to finalize the confirmation.

— Jordan Blake
Director of Sales, Redwood Inference
+1 650-555-0148

Attachments: commercial-bands.pdf

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@edgecollective.ai>
To: jordan_blake <jordan@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@edgecollective.ai, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 09:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Thanks for the demo — follow-up on cost scenarios

Thanks Jordan and Priyom — the bands are helpful. A couple of clarifying notes from procurement:

- They want the credit application to be visible on invoices/portal when applied.
- For the pilot, they'd like an initial 50k credits and the 200k top-up to be conditional on hitting a 7-day rolling burn of >150k credits and a one-time 15-min sync.
- Requesting a single point of contact for billing during the pilot.

We are comfortable starting at the Moderate target and will schedule the trace upload today. Can you confirm who will be the billing contact and whether the credits show in the portal?

Best,
Liam

--
On a related note, procurement asked for an estimated timeline for procurement review once we submit the PO (typical is 2-3 weeks internally).

From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@edgecollective.ai>, jordan_blake <jordan@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@edgecollective.ai
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Thanks for the demo — follow-up on cost scenarios

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear ask. Marissa here (redwood billing ops).

Quick answers:
- Credits are visible in the customer portal under Billing -> Credits and will also appear as a line item on the invoice when applied.
- We will provision the initial 50,000 trial credits today and note the potential 200,000 top-up tied to the 7-day >150k burn trigger.
- Billing contact during the pilot: marissa@redwood.ai (me). I will be your single point of contact for any invoice/credit questions.
- Procurement timeline: from our side we turn around standard PO acceptance in 2-4 business days once the PO and signed MPA are uploaded to our DocuSign reference. Their internal 2-3 week review window is expected.

Next steps we will do from our side
1) Apply 50k credits to the Edge Collective account and confirm in the portal (I will send a portal screenshot shortly).
2) Run the 48-hr trace eval once you upload the trace to the secure link in the HubSpot deal.
3) If the 7-day trigger is hit, we'll schedule the 15-min ops sync and approve the 200k top-up.

I'll follow up with the portal screenshot and the DocuSign link for the MPA.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Billing & Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
